title: Writing Task 2 - Genetic Engineering
description: IELTS Writing Task 2: Discuss the benefits and ethical concerns of genetic engineering in food production.

stimuli.title: Task 2: Genetic Engineering in Food Production
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

Genetic engineering is increasingly used in food production to create crops that are more resistant to disease and produce higher yields. However, many people are concerned about the long-term effects of genetically modified foods. Do the benefits of genetic engineering in food production outweigh the risks?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questionGroups.instruction: Write an essay evaluating whether the benefits of genetic engineering in food production outweigh the risks.

questions.content: Do the benefits of genetic engineering in food production outweigh the risks? Discuss and give your view.

bandDescriptors.taskResponse: Weigh benefits against risks clearly, with a reasoned conclusion about which side prevails
bandDescriptors.coherence: Balance discussion with equal treatment of both sides before stating a final position
bandDescriptors.lexicalResource: Use scientific and agricultural vocabulary: GMO, biodiversity, pesticide resistance, crop yield
bandDescriptors.grammaticalRange: Use passive voice for scientific processes and varied complex sentence structures

sampleIdeas: GM crops can be engineered to withstand drought, pests, and disease, improving food security
Higher yields from GM crops could help feed a growing global population
Potential risks include reduced biodiversity, unforeseen ecosystem impacts, and allergic reactions
Large corporations controlling GM seed patents may create dependency for small-scale farmers
